title: Add SDK instruction descriptor fixtures
summary: Workspace SDK export fixtures exist, but the current Solana instruction descriptor contract also needs committed fixtures for instruction names, account order, and data keys until generated protocol bindings exist.
expectedFailureModes: Instruction descriptor names or account ordering change silently without fixture evidence.
Fixture comparison gives false confidence by ignoring data keys or account order.
Docs confuse handwritten descriptor fixtures with generated protocol bindings or public semver guarantees.
nextAction: Add SDK instruction descriptor fixtures, compare them in the SDK compatibility report, and update docs/status without claiming generated binding or public npm stability.
